tasks.description: Set up the core project team structure consisting of 4-5 people as specified in the requirements. This includes identifying and assigning roles for: Product Manager (1), Technical Lead (1), Backend/CLI Developers (2), and Quality Assurance (1). The team structure must be documented and formalized with clear reporting lines and communication channels. This is a foundational task that enables all subsequent project work.

parameters.deliverable_format: Team structure documentation with roles and reporting hierarchy

tasks.task_notes: This is a critical first step. Without a properly structured team, subsequent tasks cannot be effectively distributed or executed. Consider availability and skill match when assigning roles.

requirement_snippets:
### **6.1 Core Team Structure**
```
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
```
constraints: Team must consist of exactly 4-5 people
Each role must be filled according to the specified count
Team structure must follow the hierarchical organization shown
success_criteria: All roles are filled with qualified individuals
Team structure documentation is complete and approved
Communication channels are established between team members

tasks.task_name: Define Product Manager Role and Responsibilities
tasks.description: Document and formalize the Product Manager role including all responsibilities and MVP deliverables as specified in the requirements. The Product Manager is responsible for: defining and prioritizing the feature roadmap, gathering user requirements and feedback, coordinating between stakeholders and development team, managing project timeline and milestones, ensuring business requirements are met, and creating user documentation and marketing materials. This role definition must be clear and actionable to enable the Product Manager to execute effectively.

responsibilities: Coordinate between stakeholders and development team

tasks.task_notes: This definition must be shared with the Product Manager hire and agreed upon. Consider creating a formal job description or role charter document. The MVP deliverables listed are critical for the project's success and should be tracked as separate work items.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials

**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must include all specified responsibilities
Must define all MVP deliverables
Role must align with overall project team structure
success_criteria: Product Manager role documentation is complete and approved
All responsibilities are clearly defined with measurable outcomes
All MVP deliverables are documented with acceptance criteria
dependencies: Establish Core Project Team Structure

tasks.task_name: Define Technical Lead Role and Responsibilities
tasks.description: Document and formalize the Technical Lead role including all responsibilities as specified in the requirements. The Technical Lead is responsible for: architecture design and technical decisions, code review and quality standards, implementation of core modules, integration with Notion API, performance and security oversight, and mentoring other developers. This role is critical for maintaining technical quality and consistency across the project.
tasks.task_notes: The Technical Lead role is particularly important for the Notion API integration aspect mentioned. Ensure the selected individual has experience with API integrations and can establish robust code review processes early in the project.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Must include all specified responsibilities
Role must align with overall project team structure
Must have authority for technical decisions and architecture
success_criteria: Technical Lead role documentation is complete and approved
All responsibilities are clearly defined with scope boundaries
Code review standards and quality processes are documented
Architecture decision-making process is established
dependencies: Establish Core Project Team Structure

tasks.task_name: Create User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
tasks.description: Generate comprehensive user stories and acceptance criteria for the CLI tool as part of the Product Manager's MVP deliverables. This task requires gathering user requirements, understanding stakeholder needs, and translating them into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Each user story should follow the standard format ('As a [role], I want [feature] so that [benefit]') and include specific, measurable acceptance criteria that can be verified during testing.

parameters.story_format: As a [role], I want [feature] so that [benefit]

tasks.task_notes: This is a Product Manager deliverable. User stories should cover the full scope of the CLI tool functionality. Consider organizing stories by epic or feature area. Acceptance criteria should be detailed enough for QA to create test cases.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must be deliverable for MVP
Must follow standard user story format
Acceptance criteria must be measurable and testable
success_criteria: All user stories are documented and approved
Each story has clear acceptance criteria
Stories cover complete CLI tool functionality
Acceptance criteria are validated by QA team
dependencies: Define Product Manager Role and Responsibilities

tasks.description: Create a comprehensive MVP scope definition document that clearly outlines what features and functionality will be included in the minimum viable product for the CLI tool. This is a critical Product Manager deliverable that sets boundaries for the initial release and helps the team focus on core functionality. The scope should balance user needs with development constraints and timeline requirements.
tasks.task_notes: This scope definition should be created early and agreed upon by all stakeholders. Be realistic about what can be achieved in MVP. Features left out should be documented for future releases. Scope creep is a major risk - this document helps prevent it.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must be deliverable for MVP
Scope must be achievable within project constraints
Must clearly distinguish in-scope vs out-of-scope features
success_criteria: MVP scope document is complete and approved by stakeholders
Clear feature list with in-scope and out-of-scope items
Success metrics are defined and measurable
Release criteria are documented and agreed upon
dependencies: Define Product Manager Role and Responsibilities
Create User Stories and Acceptance Criteria

tasks.description: Create a comprehensive user testing plan for the CLI tool as part of the Product Manager's MVP deliverables. This plan should outline the testing strategy, methodology, participant selection criteria, test scenarios, and success metrics. The plan must ensure that the CLI tool meets user needs and expectations before release.
tasks.task_notes: User testing should include both usability testing and acceptance testing. Consider beta testing with real users before full release. Plan should coordinate with QA team's testing efforts. Budget and timeline for user testing should be considered.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must be deliverable for MVP
Testing must occur before full release
Plan must align with project timeline and budget
success_criteria: User testing plan is complete and approved
Testing methodology is clearly documented
Participant selection criteria are defined
Test scenarios cover critical user workflows
Feedback collection and analysis process is established
dependencies: Define Product Manager Role and Responsibilities
Define MVP Scope

tasks.task_name: Create Go-to-Market Strategy for CLI Tool
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive go-to-market strategy for the CLI tool as part of the Product Manager's MVP deliverables. This strategy should cover target audience identification, marketing channels, launch timing, messaging, user acquisition plans, and success metrics. The strategy must align with the overall product vision and ensure successful adoption of the CLI tool.
tasks.task_notes: The go-to-market strategy should be developed in parallel with product development to ensure alignment. Consider community building, documentation, and support channels as part of the strategy. Early adopter programs can provide valuable feedback.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must be deliverable for MVP
Strategy must be ready before product launch
Must align with product capabilities and positioning
success_criteria: Go-to-market strategy document is complete and approved
Target audience is clearly defined with user personas
Marketing channels and tactics are documented with budget
Launch timeline is established and coordinated with development
User acquisition goals and metrics are defined
dependencies: Define Product Manager Role and Responsibilities
Define MVP Scope
Develop User Testing Plan

tasks.description: Design the overall system architecture for the CLI tool as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This includes making critical architectural decisions about system components, data flow, API integration patterns (especially for Notion API), technology stack, deployment architecture, and scalability considerations. The architecture must be documented in detail to guide implementation.
tasks.task_notes: This is a critical Technical Lead responsibility. Architecture decisions made here will impact the entire project. Special attention should be paid to the Notion API integration requirements. Consider creating architecture decision records (ADRs) for major decisions.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Architecture must support Notion API integration
Must address performance and security requirements
Must be scalable and maintainable
success_criteria: Architecture document is complete and approved by stakeholders
All major architectural decisions are documented with rationale
Architecture supports all MVP requirements
Security and performance considerations are addressed
Development team understands and agrees with the architecture
dependencies: Define Technical Lead Role and Responsibilities
Define MVP Scope

tasks.task_name: Establish Code Review and Quality Standards
tasks.description: Establish comprehensive code review processes and quality standards as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This includes defining coding standards, review procedures, quality gates, testing requirements, and documentation standards. These standards ensure consistency and quality across all code developed by the team.

parameters.output_format: Code review and quality standards document

tasks.task_notes: These standards should be established early before significant development begins. Consider using linters, formatters, and automated quality checks. The review process should balance thoroughness with velocity. Training may be needed for the team on the standards.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Standards must be clear and enforceable
Process must not create bottlenecks
Must align with industry best practices
success_criteria: Code review and quality standards document is complete and approved
All team members are trained on the standards
Automated quality checks are in place where applicable
Review process is documented with clear procedures
Quality metrics are defined and measurable
dependencies: Define Technical Lead Role and Responsibilities

tasks.description: Implement the core modules of the CLI tool as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This involves hands-on development of the foundational components that other features will build upon. The core modules should be well-architected, thoroughly tested, and serve as examples of code quality for the team.

parameters.output_format: Implemented core modules with tests and documentation

tasks.task_notes: This is a hands-on implementation task for the Technical Lead. Core modules should be identified during architecture design. Implementation should follow established quality standards and serve as a reference for other developers. Consider pair programming with Backend/CLI developers for knowledge transfer.

tasks.description: Implement integration with the Notion API as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This is a critical component that requires understanding the Notion API capabilities, authentication mechanisms, rate limiting, error handling, and data synchronization patterns. The integration must be robust, secure, and performant.
tasks.task_notes: Notion API integration is mentioned specifically in the Technical Lead's responsibilities, indicating its criticality. Review Notion API documentation thoroughly. Consider rate limits and implement appropriate throttling. Error handling must be robust given the dependency on an external service. Security oversight is mentioned as a responsibility - ensure credentials are handled securely.

tasks.task_name: Establish Performance and Security Oversight Process
tasks.description: Establish processes and practices for performance and security oversight as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This includes defining performance benchmarks, security review procedures, monitoring and alerting, vulnerability scanning, and incident response. These oversight mechanisms ensure the system remains performant and secure throughout development and after deployment.
tasks.task_notes: Performance and security are explicitly called out in the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This should be set up early. Consider automated tools for both performance monitoring and security scanning. Regular security reviews should be part of the development cycle. Performance testing should be integrated into CI/CD.

The Technical Lead should mentor Backend/CLI developers to ensure they can work effectively and grow their skills.
tasks.task_notes: Mentoring is explicitly listed as a Technical Lead responsibility. This is important for team development and knowledge distribution. The program should be structured but flexible. Consider the specific needs of the Backend/CLI developers on the team. Time should be allocated for mentoring activities.
